name: metadata-driven-ingestion
description: Metadata-driven ingestion pipeline. The only external input is input_file; runtime_metadata resolves everything else (mapping, schema, sinks, DLQ routing).

parameters.name: input_file
parameters.label: Input file
parameters.helpText: File name/path used by runtime_metadata loader to resolve ingestion mapping, schema contract, sinks, and Dataflow options. Example: incoming/clinical/20251229/synthea/patients.csv (or a gs:// URI if your loader expects it).
